messages.text:
Two final checks failed only for recursive modes with an absolute path.

I’d matched relative recursion, but absolute child headers are joining in a slightly different way, so I’m checking that diff and tightening path display.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$ref=(Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); $tmp=Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'verify_dir'; if(Test-Path "'$tmp){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp}; New-Item -ItemType Directory $tmp | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path $tmp '"'b.txt') -Value 'hello'; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'a') -Value 'x'; New-Item -ItemType Directory (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'dir') | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline -Path (Join-Path "'$tmp '"'dir\\z') -Value 'z'; foreach("'$c in @(@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-T',"'$tmp),@('"'--color=never','--icons=never','-R','-l',"'$tmp))){ & $ref @c >r.out 2>r.err; & python ./executable @c >p.out 2>p.err; "--- $($c -join '"' ')\"; \"REF\"; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 r.out; \"PY\"; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding utf8 p.out }; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "'$tmp; Remove-Item -Force r.out,r.err,p.out,p.err'
